# Example 1

## Sorted list of QB's with most air yards

### The Input  

```         
SELECT players.first_name, players.last_name, 
       SUM(pass_stats.amount) AS total_air_yards
FROM pass_stats 
JOIN players ON pass_stats.player_id = players.player_id
WHERE stat_type = 'air_yards'
GROUP BY players.player_id
ORDER BY total_air_yards DESC
```

### The Result

```{python}
import sqlite3 as sq
import pandas as pd
from itables import show
db = sq.connect('nfl_players.db')
records=pd.read_sql("""
    select players.first_name, players.last_name, sum(pass_stats.amount) as total_air_yards
    from pass_stats join players ON pass_stats.player_id = players.player_id
    where stat_type = "air_yards"
    group by players.player_id
    order by total_air_yards desc
    """,db)
show(records,searching=False,ordering=True,showIndex=False,info=False)
```

# Example 2

## Average rushing YPA by number of box defenders

### The Input

```         
SELECT round(avg(r.amount),1) as YPA,r.defenders_in_box as Box_Defenders
FROM rush_stats r join players p ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE stat_type = "rushing_yards" and Box_Defenders is NOT NULL
GROUP BY Box_Defenders
```

### The Result

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import sqlite3 as sq
import plotly.graph_objects as go
db = sq.connect('nfl_players.db')
records=pd.read_sql("""
SELECT round(avg(r.amount),1) as YPA,r.defenders_in_box as Box_Defenders
FROM rush_stats r join players p ON p.player_id = r.player_id
where stat_type = "rushing_yards" and Box_Defenders is NOT NULL
group by Box_Defenders
    """,db)


fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=records['Box_Defenders'],
    y=records['YPA'],
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='steelblue', width=3)
)).update_layout(xaxis_title="Box Defenders",yaxis_title="YPA")
```

# Example 3

## Using a View to plot team's average offensive output

### The Input

#### View - "passing_epa_by_team"

```         
SELECT round(avg(ps.amount),3) as Pass_EPA, p.team as Team
FROM pass_stats ps JOIN players p on p.player_id=ps.player_id
WHERE stat_type = 'epa'
GROUP BY p.team
ORDER BY Pass_EPA desc
```

#### View - "rushing_epa_by_team"

```         
SELECT round(avg(r.amount),3) as Rush_EPA, p.team as Team
FROM rush_stats r 
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = r.player_id
WHERE stat_type = "epa"
GROUP BY p.team
ORDER BY Rush_EPA Desc
```

#### Query

```         
SELECT p.Team, p.Pass_EPA, r.Rush_EPA
FROM passing_epa_by_team p
JOIN rushing_epa_by_team r ON p.Team = r.Team
```

### The Result

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import sqlite3 as sq
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
db = sq.connect('nfl_players.db')
records=pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT p.Team, p.Pass_EPA, r.Rush_EPA
    FROM passing_epa_by_team p
    JOIN rushing_epa_by_team r ON p.Team = r.Team
    """,db)
avg_pass = records['Pass_EPA'].mean()
avg_rush = records['Rush_EPA'].mean()
ax=records.plot.scatter(x="Pass_EPA",y="Rush_EPA")
for i, txt in enumerate(records['Team']):
    ax.annotate(txt, (records['Pass_EPA'].iloc[i], records['Rush_EPA'].iloc[i]), 
            xytext=(5,5), textcoords='offset points')

plt.axhline(y=avg_rush, color='r', linestyle='--')
plt.axvline(x=avg_pass, color='r', linestyle='--')
ax.text(0.02, 0.98, "--- League Average", transform=ax.transAxes, 
        color='r', fontsize=20, verticalalignment='top');
fig=plt.gcf().set_size_inches(20,10);
```
